Get Products > OpenAPI definition #/components/schemas/AEProductCategoryCodes

{
  "description": "The supported product category codes for banking products.",
  "type": "string",
  "enum": [
    "SavingsAccount",
    "CurrentAccount",
    "CreditCard",
    "Finance",
    "Mortgage"
  ]
}

Get Products > OpenAPI definition #/components/schemas/AEProductResidencyStatusCodes

{
  "type": "string",
  "description": "The type of residence status eligible for the product or product requirement.",
  "enum": [
    "UaeResident",
    "ExpatriatesResident",
    "GCCNational",
    "NonUaeResident"
  ]
}

Get Products > OpenAPI definition #/components/schemas/ActiveOrHistoricCurrencyCode_0

{
  "description": "Identification of the currency in which the account is held. A code allocated to a currency under an international currency identification scheme, as described in the latest edition of the international standard ISO 4217 'Codes for the representation of currencies and funds'.",
  "type": "string",
  "pattern": "^[A-Z]{3,3}$",
  "example": "AED"
}

Get Products > OpenAPI definition #/components/schemas/ActiveOrHistoricCurrencyCode_1

{
  "description": "A 3 character alphabetic code allocated to a currency under an international currency identification scheme, as described in the latest edition of the international standard ISO 4217 'Codes for the representation of currencies and funds'.",
  "type": "string",
  "pattern": "^[A-Z]{3,3}$",
  "example": "AED"
}

Get Products > OpenAPI definition #/components/schemas/AEDuration

{
  "type": "string",
  "pattern": "^P(\\d+Y)?(\\d+M)?$",
  "format": "duration",
  "description": "A period of time implemented using ISO 8601 compatible duration format",
  "example": "P2Y3M"
}
